body:
The diagram below shows how coins are made at a national mint, from the arrival of metal at the factory to the delivery of finished coins to banks.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: How coins are minted at a national mint
steps: Metal is delivered to the mint in large sheets
Sheets are rolled into a long strip of the correct thickness
Blank discs are punched out of the metal strip
Discs are cleaned and heated so that the metal softens
A press stamps the design onto both faces of each disc
Coins that fail weight or size checks are returned to be melted
Accepted coins are counted, bagged and sent to banks

body:
The diagram below shows the stages in the production of a cotton T-shirt, from the planting of cotton to the arrival of the shirt in shops.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: How a cotton T-shirt is produced, from field to shop
steps: Cotton seeds are planted on large farms in warm regions
Cotton bolls are harvested by machine once they open
Raw cotton is taken to a ginnery
Seeds are removed and fibres are pressed into bales
Fibres are spun into yarn on large machines
Yarn is knitted into long tubes of fabric
Fabric is dyed, washed and dried
Fabric is cut into body and sleeve panels
Panels are sewn together and checked for faults
Faulty shirts are returned to the sewing line for repair
Finished shirts are pressed, folded and packed
Packed shirts are shipped to warehouses and then to shops

body:
The diagram below shows the stages a company goes through when it recruits a new employee, including the points at which applicants are rejected.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chart.title: How a company recruits a new employee
steps: A manager submits a request to fill a vacancy
HR advertises the post on job boards and the company website
Applications are screened against the essential criteria
Applicants who do not meet the criteria receive a rejection letter
Shortlisted candidates complete an online aptitude test
Candidates below the pass mark are rejected and given feedback
Remaining candidates attend a panel interview
The panel scores each candidate and selects the strongest
HR checks references before any offer is made
A written offer is sent to the chosen candidate
If the offer is declined, the next-ranked candidate is contacted
The successful candidate signs the contract and starts work
